The research program conducts multiple NIH-funded projects that are part of national collaborative research networks, including the NIH HEAL Initiative, NIDA Rural Opioid Initiative, and the Justice Community Opioid Innovation Network. The coordinator will help lead and coordinate the work of NIH funded projects, working closely with the Program PI, research program colleagues, and a team of diverse faculty across [Company name masked] and other institutions with expertise in statistics, engineering, public health, nursing, and epidemiology.
The Clinical Research Project Coordinator will provide overall management and coordination of the research activities and data collection of a primary research project, with additional support of other currently funded projects. SynRG is a collaboration between the Division of Infectious Diseases at [Company name masked], the Communicable Disease Harm Reduction Section in the [Location masked] Division of Public Health, and a non-profit community based organization serving people living with and at risk for HIV.
The program runs multiple NIH-funded projects that are part of national collaborative research networks, including the NIH HEAL Initiative, NIDA Rural Opioid Initiative, and the Justice Community Opioid Innovation Network. The successful candidate will lead and drive the work of NIH funded projects, working directly with Program PI Dr. Ryan Westergaard, research program colleagues, and a team of diverse faculty across [Company name masked] and other institutions with expertise in statistics, engineering, public health, nursing, and epidemiology.
The Clinical Research Project Coordinator will take full ownership of the management and coordination of research activities and data collection for a primary research project, with additional responsibility for other currently funded projects. The research program is currently executing 3 NIH funded projects focusing on HIV care, addiction and overdose, incarcerated individuals, and harm reduction initiatives.

Lead and coordinate the research activities and data collection of a primary NIH-funded research project

Direct communication and collaboration with the Program PI, research colleagues, and faculty across institutions
Execute project protocols and ensure they are accessible to a variety of audiences
Manage and organize processes and plans to achieve project milestones
Oversee data management and analysis activities
Supervise employees and delegate tasks as needed
Conduct community-based human subjects research with populations disproportionately impacted by substance use and/or HIV or hepatitis C

Education:

[Company name masked] is seeking a Project Coordinator to join the Syndemics Research Group (SynRG), a collaboration between the Division of Infectious Diseases, the Communicable Disease Harm Reduction Section in the [Location masked] Division of Public Health, and a non-profit community based organization serving people living with and at risk for HIV.
The program runs multiple NIH-funded projects within national collaborative research networks, including the NIH HEAL Initiative, NIDA Rural Opioid Initiative, and the Justice Community Opioid Innovation Network. The selected candidate will lead and coordinate NIH-funded project work, partnering closely with Program PI Dr. Ryan Westergaard, research program colleagues, and a multidisciplinary faculty team across [Company name masked] and other institutions with expertise in statistics, engineering, public health, nursing, and epidemiology.
The Clinical Research Project Coordinator will take ownership of the overall management and coordination of research activities and data collection for a primary research project, with additional responsibility for other currently funded projects. The research program is currently executing 3 NIH-funded projects focused on HIV care, addiction and overdose, incarcerated individuals, and harm reduction initiatives.

Clinical Research Project Coordinator I (RE102)
Clinical Research Project Coordinator II (RE103)
